question: Which point-in-time feature-engineering families add stable signal for T0 and T1 without temporal clocks or outcome-derived features?
primary_change: Compare a pre-registered ladder on train/validation only: atomic sanitized baseline; continuous/specificity transforms; semantic Need features; train-only soft clusters; and Lead×Spot semantic interactions.
validation: Development only. Train fits transformations/models; validation chooses one winner per stage. E030 test is not inspected by E031.

items.evidence: All derived features use fields observable at score_time.
All clusterers fit on train only and never see target.
No calendar/progress clocks, Availability LeadQuality fields, broker outcomes/prior, Market Context, or current-state Spot aggregates.
Validation may select a candidate; test remains sealed for E032/E033.
